For a 2-item set that is either 2 of 2, which is a strictly harder test than the one that was agreed, or it is a number nobody has chosen. It must be re-decided. (2) E3-S6, 'does it catch the polite disagreement?', was written around T3-Q03 and no longer has a subject. T3-Q01 and T3-Q02 are both explicit disagreements, so the fixture no longer contains a case that punishes a system for keying on tone - which was the entire reason the third one was written. Replacing that coverage needs a NEW fixture, not a relabelled one.
